name: Counterfeit and Pirated Goods
description: Manufacture, import and sale of fake goods such as apparel, pharmaceuticals, electronics and auto parts, infringing intellectual property and often endangering consumers. Proceeds pass through online marketplaces, small importers and shell traders.

sources.text: OECD and EUIPO, Trends in Trade in Counterfeit and Pirated Goods (2019)
OECD, Illicit Trade: Converging Criminal Networks (2016)
World Customs Organization, public material on IP enforcement
FATF, Money Laundering Vulnerabilities of Free Trade Zones (2010)

exposure.rationale: Online marketplace sellers, small importers and shell traders.

indicators.name: Branded goods at prices far below genuine retail
indicators.canon: Branded or duty-paid goods priced far below genuine market levels
indicators.desc: Prices are implausibly low for authentic or duty-paid products, suggesting counterfeit or illicit supply.

indicators.name: Importer of brand-name goods with no distribution authorisation
indicators.canon: Importer of brand-name goods with no distribution authorisation
indicators.desc: No authorisation or licence from brand owner.
indicators.ctx: No authorisation or licence from brand owner.
indicators.fp: Parallel imports are lawful in places.

indicators.name: Trade documents with imprecise descriptions or mismatched HS codes
indicators.desc: Trade documents use generic terms or imprecise descriptions or mismatched HS codes where specifics would be expected.

indicators.name: Shipments transiting free zones and repackaged
indicators.canon: Shipments transiting free zones and repackaged

indicators.name: Many small online storefronts with common bank accounts or directors
indicators.canon: Many small online storefronts with common bank accounts or directors
indicators.fp: Same owner may run several shops.

indicators.name: Payments to manufacturers in known counterfeit production regions with no brand
indicators.canon: Payments to manufacturers in known counterfeit production regions with no brand

indicators.name: Counterfeit pharmaceuticals or safety-critical parts
indicators.desc: Medicines or auto parts from unlicensed sources.
indicators.ctx: Medicines or auto parts from unlicensed sources.

indicators.name: Merchant chargebacks and complaints about fake goods
indicators.canon: Merchant chargebacks and complaints about fake goods
